page_title: BRE 0-0 NAN | Brest v Nantes 04/10/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+2' The ball is out of play. Brest will have a chance to score from a corner.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.

90' Ludovic Ajorque (Brest) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and smashes a glorious looking effort towards the roof of the net, but Anthony Lopes thwarts him with a great two-handed save.
87' Hyun-Seok Hong is being substituted because of an injury. Luis Castro sends Nicolas Cozza (Nantes) on the pitch.
85' Problems for Luis Castro as Dehmaine Tabibou is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Bahmed Deuff (Nantes) replaces him.
85' The manager makes a subsitution with Youssef El Arabi (Nantes) coming on for Mostafa Mohamed.
84' Dehmaine Tabibou (Nantes) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
82' A spell of possession for Nantes in an attempt to control the game.
78' Here is a change. Junior Dina Ebimbe is going off and Eric Roy gives the last tactical orders to Hamidou Makalou (Brest).
78' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Pathe Mboup walks off the pitch to be replaced by Daouda Guindo (Brest).
77' Kamory Doumbia (Brest) takes the corner, but he overhits it and none of his teammates are able to reach the ball.
77' Pathe Mboup (Brest) sends a weak shot high over the bar from the edge of the box.
75' The ball is cleared after Matthis Abline (Nantes) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
74' Hyun-Seok Hong (Nantes) is in a clear offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
74' Neat passing move from Nantes in order to create new attacking opportunities.
73' Ludovic Ajorque (Brest) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
72' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Brest, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
67' Ludovic Ajorque (Brest) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
66' The ball goes out of play and Nantes have been awarded a corner kick.
64' The referee signals a substitution. Bahereba Guirassy (Nantes) is brought on as a substitute for Mayckel Lahdo.
60' The ball is out of play. Brest win a corner kick.
58' Brest have a corner.
57' Pathe Mboup (Brest) rises high to head a nice lofted cross towards the top left corner. Unfortunately for him, his close-range effort lacks pace and Anthony Lopes makes a comfortable save.
53' Luis Castro (Nantes) picks up a yellow card for unsporting behaviour after the half-time whistle. He should have gone straight into the dressing room instead.
52' Nantes win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
50' Kamory Doumbia (Brest) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
47' Nantes control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
46' The second half has just started.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
43' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Nantes.
41' The corner from Kamory Doumbia (Brest) is intercepted by Anthony Lopes.
40' Kamory Doumbia (Brest) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender. Brest force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
39' Kamory Doumbia (Brest) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
38' Brest force a corner. They send men into the box.
37' A brilliant cross into the box finds Junior Dina Ebimbe (Brest), who directs his header towards the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper shows his agility and makes an astonishing save.
36' One of the players from Brest times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.

35' Bradley Locko (Brest) runs onto the ball inside the box and smashes it towards the bottom left corner. It's a great effort but an even better save from Anthony Lopes, who tips the ball around the post.
32' Junior Mwanga (Nantes) sends an accurate short pass. Chidozie Awaziem controls the ball with a fine first touch and is able to come up with a new attacking effort.
30' Kamory Doumbia (Brest) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
29' Gael Angoula blows his whistle. Kelvin Amian (Nantes) commits a foul after dangerous play. A free kick has been awarded to Brest.
28' The resulting corner from Hyun-Seok Hong (Nantes) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
27' Brest are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
24' Nantes string together a series of short passes.
23' Dehmaine Tabibou (Nantes) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.

22' Nantes are playing some nice combination football, sending it precisely from player to player, but a defender shows good anticipation and ends the move with a good block. It's a throw-in for Nantes.
18' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Brest.
17' Gael Angoula shows a yellow card to Pathe Mboup (Brest) for a tough tackle.
15' Bradley Locko (Brest) extricates himself from the difficult situation with a good pass, comfortably eluding the pressing opponent.
15' Brest are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
14' Brest can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
13' Brest take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
10' Chidozie Awaziem (Nantes) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Gael Angoula had an easy-decision to make.
7' The corner is swung in but Brest can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
5' Chidozie Awaziem (Nantes) and Kelvin Amian matched up again to find some space for an unmarked teammate.
3' Nantes failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
2' The Nantes players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Nantes will have the kick-off.
Gael Angoula was nominated as the referee for this game.
